_comment: Cue sheet owned by the audio session. The dev session appends requests here (or sends them by cross-session message); the audio session renders them with generate.mjs.

title.prompt: Instrumental J-pop synthwave title theme for a cartoon magic-shooter game set in a neon Tokyo shrine district at night. 104 BPM, bright analog synth arps, punchy drums, playful koto and shamisen accents, catchy hook, loopable, about 90 seconds. No vocals.

battle.prompt: Instrumental high-energy battle music for a 4v4 arcade team shooter with hand-gesture magic. 138 BPM, driving synthwave bass, chiptune leads, taiko hits, festival (matsuri) flute riffs, tension builds, loopable, about 150 seconds. No vocals.

victory.prompt: Short instrumental victory fanfare jingle, cheerful synth brass and taiko, anime game style, 8 seconds, ends cleanly. No vocals.

fingergun.text: cartoon magic finger-gun shot, bright sparkly zap with a snappy 'pew', arcade game

doubletap.text: magical shotgun blast, two-finger spell burst, crunchy sparkle boom, arcade

scope.text: powerful magic sniper beam shot, charged crack and long sparkling tail

horns.text: rapid magic rifle single shot, short bright pop, for full-auto loop

trinity.text: crisp magic burst rifle shot, glassy chime pop

seal.text: heavy magical barrage shot, deep thump with crackle

hit.text: satisfying hit marker tick, short high ding

headshot.text: headshot confirmation, metallic double ding with sparkle

kill.text: elimination confirmation chime, three rising bright notes, arcade

hurt.text: player takes damage, soft thud with cartoon grunt-free whoosh

death.text: cartoon wizard knocked out, descending magical poof and sparkle burst

reload.text: blowing on fingertip like smoking gun, soft 'fuu' breath then tiny chime

swap.text: quick glove finger snap and whoosh for switching hand gesture

cast.text: magic spell cast, rising sparkly whoosh

phase.text: teleport blink, warped whoosh reversing into pop

veil.text: invisibility spell, shimmering glassy fade out

explode.text: magical fire explosion, boomy but cartoonish, sparkles

heal.text: healing spell, warm ascending chime arpeggio

step.text: single soft footstep on stone pavement

jump.text: light jump whoosh with cloth rustle
